title: Potpie Context Graph: trust-provenance loss (potpie-context-provenance, Aug 2026)

nodes.agent_context_poisoned: Attacker-controlled content reaches an external coding agent (Claude Code/Cursor/Codex) indistinguishable from trusted context
nodes.claim_written: The reconciliation LLM writes malicious text into ClaimRow.fact/description with no provenance marker (Stage 2->3, ClaimRow/EvidenceItem)
nodes.schema_no_trust_field: The ClaimRow/EvidenceItem schema in potpie-context-core has no trust/provenance field; truth/confidence/evidence_strength are about epistemic, not security, trustworthiness (root cause, verified directly via dataclasses.fields())
nodes.i1_github_webhook_no_author_gate: I-1: GitHub webhook — _verify_signature() only confirms delivery came from GitHub, does not check the issue author's author_association/collaborator status (verified directly, connector.py:266-270)
nodes.i2_linear_webhook_secret_optional: I-2: Linear webhook — signature verification is skipped entirely if LINEAR_WEBHOOK_SECRET is unset (verified directly, sources_router.py:317-332)
nodes.i3_agent_mediated_ingestion: I-3: skill potpie-source-ingestion — the in-session agent itself reads PRs/issues/tickets and writes claims; required fields are epistemic only (verified directly for the skill's stated purpose, reported for the absence of a warning across the whole file)
nodes.i4_context_record_api: I-4: POST /context/record — ContextRecordPayload (pydantic) validates summary only structurally (min_length=1), never checks the content itself; require_api_key fails closed by default, but that authenticates the sender, not the text (verified directly, router.py:225-231,1388-1459 @ potpie-ai/potpie b5a67742, 2026-08-04 re-verification)
nodes.e1_nudge_hook_unfenced: E-1: render_output() inserts str(text) into the additionalContext/systemMessage of the SessionStart/PreToolUse/PostToolUse/Stop hook with no fence/tag; fires automatically (verified directly, potpie_nudge.py:397-422)
nodes.e2_cli_read_verbatim: E-2: `potpie graph read --relations full` prints fact verbatim as plain text (verified directly, read_presenter.py)
nodes.e3_graph_neighborhood_full: E-3: `potpie graph neighborhood --detail full` returns node properties unfiltered (verified directly by reading the code, graph.py:1449-1466)
nodes.e4_graph_search_entities: E-4: `potpie graph search-entities` returns summary/description + supporting_claims with the raw fact (reported, re-verified: same claim_payload())
nodes.e5_inline_relations: E-5: inline relations in `graph read` — _assemble_inline_relation_items()/_relation_payload() puts payload['fact'] raw into every relation item, unfiltered (verified directly, graph_service.py:1490,1637-1669 @ potpie-ai/potpie b5a67742, 2026-08-04 re-verification)
nodes.e6_daemon_http_ui: E-6: Daemon HTTP UI (/api/graph,/api/neighborhood,/api/read,/api/search) — properties with no content filtering, scoped to localhost+bearer token (verified directly for the dump behavior, reported for the gate's details)
nodes.e8_secondary_stdout_channels: E-8: `graph inbox list/show`, `graph quality *`, `graph history` print summary/finding verbatim via f-string with no fencing (_inbox_human/_quality_human/_history_human, cli/commands/graph.py:3562-3614); `timeline recent` goes through the same read pipeline as E-2 (verified directly @ potpie-ai/potpie b5a67742, 2026-08-04 re-verification)

_note_for_reader:
The graph is built from RESEARCH.md and docs/VECTOR-MAP.md of the potpie-context-provenance repository (state: potpie-ai/potpie @ b5a67742). All known ingress and egress channels are already encoded as disjunctive hyperedges (several edges sharing one head) — Σ is empty and not needed, because the alternative paths are not hypothetical, they are actually documented in the vector map. sigma_completeness=enumerated reflects this: the LB verdicts here are NOT conditional on incompleteness of Σ, only on the completeness of the vector map itself. Expected result: schema_no_trust_field and claim_written are LB (the only truly load-bearing nodes, matching thesis Q5 in RESEARCH.md); every i*/e* node individually is SC (patching one channel does not break the attack while any alternative survives).

2026-08-04 re-verification (see SOURCES.md): 4 nodes marked in the original vector map as 'reported, not independently re-verified' (I-4, E-5, E-7, E-8) were re-checked directly against potpie-ai/potpie@b5a67742 source. Three were confirmed (I-4, E-5, E-8 — node texts updated with file:line citations). The fourth, E-7 (/context/graph/query), was NOT confirmed: at this commit the endpoint /context/query/context-graph is a stub that always returns HTTP 501 and never returns graph data. Node e7_context_engine_api and edge e_out7 were removed from the graph as disproved. This does not change the load-bearing core (schema_no_trust_field/claim_written remain LB), but it changes the scaffolding (SC) count from 12 to 11 nodes, and is itself a separate methodological result: differential re-verification caught a stale/incorrect claim in the originally published vector map.
